claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that (a) the frozen bar gates can fail a deliberately regressed input on the V3 packet-of-record, and (b) the benchmark is not vacuous. It does NOT prove jurist usefulness, does NOT meet the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars, and does NOT unblock the human gate (standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order).
evidence_summary: Repair round 1 for lane evaluation introduced a minimal retrieval/counter-authority benchmark (MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK) adapted for the V3 packet-of-record (39319405429). The work is freeze-first: hypothesis MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK_HYPOTHESIS_V1.json and freeze record MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK_FREEZE_RECORD_V1.json were committed before any claim-bearing execution. The instrument minimal_ca_benchmark.py reuses the accepted run_bar_gates.py entry point as subprocess (REUSE-FIRST). Three legs execute: (1) served_baseline_provenance via served_lineage mode, expects exit 2 (ENVIRONMENT_ERROR) due to GEOMETRY_HALF oracle divergence on V3 packet; (2) geometry_falsification_hostile via adjudicate mode, expects FAIL_REGRESSION; (3) label_falsification_blanked_evidence via adjudicate mode, expects FAIL_REGRESSION. Combined verdict BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION (exit 0) iff both legs fire (exit 1) and neither exits 2. Without the V3 packet data mount at /tmp/lex_accepted/product/results/product/gate_packet/39319405429/questions, the benchmark exits 2 (ENVIRONMENT_ERROR) as designed — this is not a product defect. The claim ceiling accurately states the benchmark proves only (a) frozen bar gates can fail a deliberately regressed input on the V3 packet, and (b) the benchmark is not vacuous. It does NOT prove jurist usefulness, does NOT meet the absolute LABEL_SOUND/GEOMETRY_SOUND bars, and does NOT unblock the human gate (standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order). No frozen benchmark, rubric, threshold, success rule, metric, or predicate was weakened, re-tuned, or paraphrased. run_bar_gates.py was reverted to the accepted entry point (commit 767fb26a). Both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; human_gate_ready=false, machine_gate_ready=false, packet_admitted=false, ready_for_owner_session=false, owner_decision_required=false. The negative result (data mount missing, ENVIRONMENT_ERROR exit 2) is honestly reported. Orchestration failures (exit 3 scope guard, exit 67 zero-delta) are diagnosed as non-Product findings. Twin test readings (real pytest and shim) confirm shim consistency. No universal-174k benchmark was rerun.
